name: Impromptu Networking
deliverable: Three rapid rounds of paired micro-interviews establishing shared context

steps.text: Open with two questions everyone will answer: the challenge you bring and the asset you offer this group.
Send people to stand and find a partner they do not work with day to day, then start a four-minute round.
Chime at two minutes and have the listener take the floor; close the round after both people have answered.
Run two more rounds with new partners, asking each person to sharpen the same two answers each time.
Close by asking a few people what changed in how they described their challenge or their offer.

failure: One partner talks for most of the round, so the other gets a rushed answer and the room learns only half its assets.
intervention: Stop the round on the chime and model the handoff: "If you are mid-sentence, stop; your partner's two minutes start now."
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
